items.text: Find past conversations across OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex through keyword search in the CLI or MCP. Opt-in indexing stores text locally in plaintext; refresh it explicitly.

hint.text: After enabling MCP conversation access and building the index, ask your agent: "What did we decide about the database migration?" It can find the discussion even if it happened in another supported coding tool.

items.text: Drill into a subagent's own prompts, turns and traces where retained.
Compare prompt costs, then inspect cost and context charts scoped to that prompt's turns.
Keep the selected subagent across refresh, and jump to the first or last turn inside a prompt with g/G.
CLI commands now reject unsupported or conflicting options instead of silently ignoring them.
Inspect each subagent's work, cost share and token breakdown. Read its received prompt when retained, in the terminal or live browser.
Browse earlier release highlights offline, without leaving OpenTab.

Compare your coding agents side by side, then explore each harness's projects, models and sessions.
Read a remote turn's trace on demand over SSH, without copying whole transcripts.
